meta.purpose: One compact single-column figure combines the original Figures 11 and 12. All values are synthetic, not measured.
meta.source_policy: Original hold quality and cost data are read unchanged. Read-count curves are derived from the original complete-FLOPs coefficients; no population-coverage data are invented.

read_count_slice.fixed_appends: Use the source scenario's 20 appends per user/release, with its original inherited-prefix averaging and one handover.
read_count_slice.normalization: 100*(one reconstruction - complete additional correction FLOPs)/one reconstruction. Common native work cancels in the difference. Initialization follows the source's declared amortization.
